text:
Use ML to explore the data to answer your questions!

Now that you have decided what settings need to be used to guide the machine learning model, it is time to run your investigation.

Instructions

1) Enter the Station, Start date and time, End Date and time, and choose a model selection in the WaveRunner tile.

2) Click "Run Model" in the bottom control bar.

3) When the model is completed, click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar.

4) Answer the questions to interpret your data!
